EXPRESSIONMAP.name: DAW+ Duality 1st Violins
EXPRESSIONMAP.description: Generated from the DAW+ preset 11 Strings/Synchron/31 Duality 1st Violins (tools/daw_maps.py): one sound slot per combination the preset plays. Every slot sends the colour first (program 113-116, as the player numbers them), then the articulation's program path.

GROUP.name: Color
GROUP.description: The colour layer, sent first in every slot.

GROUP.name: Legato
GROUP.description: Legato type (with Long), or the legato / slurred transition (repetitions, tremolo, trills).
